package.name: litearm
package.description:
URDF description of the 7-DOF litearm: the model, its meshes, and a display launch. Vendored from the litearm-stm32 firmware repository, where litearm/urdf/litearm.urdf is the single source of truth for the geometry and the joint limits — the same numbers the firmware's kinematics table is generated from. Do not edit the model here; change it upstream.
The link and joint names are the contract the rest of the stack reads: links base_link, joint1..joint7 and ee_link, joints joint1..joint7.
